If there was one thing someone should learn to do in Photoshop to improve the overall look of any photo what would it be?
What is one thing in Photoshop every photographer should know to do?

Curves, curves, curves, and more curves!

To me RGB curves are one of the most powerful tools in any editing platform. Whether its Photoshop, Lightroom, or even video editing such as After Effects and Premiere. Curves is one of the tools you'll most often see and it can really change most every element of color in your images.

Learn to use the curves adjustment and you'll take your photos to a whole new level.
I'm new. What exactly do curves do?

That's a bit of a complicated and lengthy answer but I'm sure your can find some great youtube tutorials. Basically it allows you to manually adjust all of the different ranges in your image. At the bottom are your shadows, middle is midtones, and top is highlights. Then you also have your colors, red green and blue, for each of these ranges as well. Drag up to increase and down to decrease.

I know that sounds confusing but like I said, find yourself a tutorial and it will better explain. A good place to start would be by learning about an "S curve". It's the most basic curve for adding contrast to an image
